{{Quote|We at ''The Perre Needmo Newshour'' have long believed in a journalistic tradition of unbiased, honestly obtained, accurate information. We report. We do not spy, we do not invent, and we do not resort to illegal methods of obtaining information.|Perre Needmo|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>}}
'''''The Perre Needmo Newshour''''' was a daily show hosted by [[Perre Needmo]] focusing on recent events in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] society. [[Jorm Alvic]], a long-time friend of Needmo's, was the director, and [[Sima Shadar]] was the producer. Beginning in [[44 ABY]], the show ran a regular segment by the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Madhi Vaandt]] on the continuing practices of [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
